description: Ross and Rachel's relationship deteriorates under jealousy and work pressure, while Monica rebuilds her life after Richard, Phoebe learns more about her family and Joey and Chandler settle deeper into their strange domestic partnership.

s03e01.description: Ross and Rachel trade embarrassing fantasies, Monica struggles with memories of Richard and Joey's hostility toward Janice begins to soften.

s03e02.description: Ross tries to get everyone ready for a museum benefit, but clothing disputes, stolen seats and personal squabbles make punctuality impossible.

s03e03.description: Monica channels her breakup into jam-making and thoughts of motherhood, while Phoebe meets a man who has been stalking Ursula.

s03e04.description: Chandler tries to commit to Janice, Ross worries about Ben's choice of toys and Joey relies on Phoebe as a fake agent.

s03e05.description: Phoebe meets her half-brother Frank Jr., while Joey builds an enormous entertainment center and the gang debates celebrity free-pass lists.

s03e06.description: A flashback shows the friends before Rachel joined them, when several unlikely romantic pairings almost happened.

s03e07.description: Monica receives the wrong bed from Janice's husband's store, Joey teaches soap acting and Ross endures dinner with Rachel's intimidating father.

s03e08.description: Joey catches Janice kissing her husband and must decide whether to tell Chandler, while Rachel and Monica struggle with babysitting Ben.

s03e09.description: Thanksgiving becomes a fiercely competitive touch-football game as Ross and Monica revive an old sibling rivalry over the Geller Cup.

s03e10.description: Rachel quits Central Perk to pursue fashion, Ross sells cookies for an injured scout and Phoebe objects to the fate of Christmas trees.

s03e11.description: A drunken Chandler cannot remember which of Joey's sisters he kissed, while Rachel gets a promising lead on a fashion job.

s03e12.description: Ross grows jealous of Rachel's coworker Mark, while Monica dates a poet and Joey auditions for a dance-heavy musical.

s03e13.description: Monica and Richard attempt a casual friendship that quickly becomes physical again, while Phoebe dates a man with an embarrassing habit.

s03e14.description: Phoebe's former singing partner wants to reunite, Chandler dates a woman tied to Joey's past and Ross resents Rachel's demanding work schedule.

s03e15.description: Ross and Rachel's jealousy and work conflicts explode until they agree to take a break, leaving both unsure what the break actually means.

s03e16.description: Rachel learns Ross slept with Chloe, turning their attempted reconciliation into a painful all-night breakup in Monica's apartment.

s03e17.description: Rachel organizes a ski trip without Ross, but the group becomes stranded and must rely on him for rescue.

s03e18.description: Chandler uses a hypnosis tape to quit smoking, Phoebe objects to Frank Jr.'s older fiancée and Monica dates wealthy businessman Pete.

s03e19.description: Rachel returns Ross's belongings and accepts a date with Mark, while Monica and Pete struggle with unequal feelings and Joey clashes with a costar.

s03e20.description: Monica inherits a cherished dollhouse, Joey and Kate grow closer and Chandler's empty promise to call Rachel's boss creates trouble.

s03e21.description: Ross sacrifices a television appearance to help injured Rachel, Pete offers Monica a restaurant and Joey and Chandler adopt a chick.

s03e22.description: Rachel's volatile new boyfriend alarms everyone at Joey's play, while Phoebe spends an absurd day waiting for customer service.

s03e23.description: Ross seeks medical help for a mysterious growth, Phoebe dates two men and Monica misreads Pete's intentions as a marriage proposal.

s03e24.description: Pete pursues ultimate fighting despite repeated beatings, while Chandler deals with a handsy boss and Ross dates one of Phoebe's friends.

s03e25.description: At a beach house, Phoebe meets a woman connected to her family, while Rachel's jealousy of Bonnie reopens the possibility of Ross.
